 Print RRB Station Master Vacancy 2026: Check Board-Wise Posts and Online Application Deadline RRB ALP admit card 2026 : The Railway Recruitment Boards ( RRB s) have released the RRB Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) CBT 1 exam on the official websites. The Computer Based Test (CBT-1) will be held on 3,4 and 5 November 2026 under CEN 01/2026. The recruitment drive covers 11,127 vacancies. Candidates must log in on the official website of the regional RRB where they applied to download the hall tickets. Aspirants need to enter important credentials such as registration number and password to access the call letters. Anyone who has forgotten the password should use the “Forgot Password” option on the login page immediately. The city intimation slip came out on 24 October, six days before the admit card was released. RRB ALP e-call letter: Steps to download admit card
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the RRB ALP admit card from the official website: Visit the official website of your regional RRB.
 Click the “RRB ALP CBT 1 Admit Card 2026” or “E-Call Letter” link on the home page.
 Enter your registration number and password.
 Submit the details to log in.
 Your admit card will appear on the screen.
 Check your name, roll number, photo, signature, exam date, shift and centre.
 Download it and take at least two printouts.
 Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the RRB ALP e-call letters. RRB ALP hall ticket: Details to be checked
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the RRB ALP hall ticket 2026 from the official website: Candidate’s name
 Registration number and roll number
 Date of birth and category
 Photograph and signature
 Exam name and post (Assistant Loco Pilot, CEN 01/2026)
 Exam date and shift timing
 Reporting time and gate closing time
 Exam centre name and full address
 Important exam-day instructions
 Aspirants are advised to stay tuned to the official websites to get the complete details about the RRB ALP recruitment process.
